PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   C. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .

3. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plane Geometry.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plane Geometry.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

5. When learning Visual Programming, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming.

6. When learning Plain Scale Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plain Scale Drawing.

7. When learning Cutting Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

10. When learning Fire Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker

   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
